title: I spent months building an AI to find value bets. Here’s what I learned.
author: RaiDeN1988
selftext:
Like many people here, I got tired of chasing “locks”, tipsters and crazy parlays.

So I started building something different.

Instead of trying to predict winners, I focused on one thing:    
\*\*Finding bets where the market is pricing the probability incorrectly.\*\*

The platform compares odds from dozens of bookmakers against our own probability models (historical data, ELO, Poisson, machine learning and market information) to identify potential value bets.

We don’t sell “guaranteed winners”.    
We don’t recommend 10-leg parlays.

We believe long-term profitability comes from:    
• Proper bankroll management.    
• Consistent staking.    
• Positive expected value.    
• Accepting variance.

We’ve been documenting every pick publicly and the early results have been encouraging, but we know 20 days don’t prove anything. The goal is to stay profitable over thousands of bets, not dozens.

I’d genuinely love to hear your thoughts:    
\*\*How do you identify value in your own betting process?\*\*

If anyone wants to follow the project, we’re sharing everything on X:    
\*\*@SmartOddsApp\*\*    
Feedback is more than welcome.
